core_obligations: Prove the inclusion is continuous and cocontinuous
Identify g^{-1} with restriction and set up the Cech comparison
Conclude the cohomology isomorphism case by case
difficulty_reason: Cohomology of a restricted sheaf along a full subcategory closed under base change: shows X' -> X is continuous and cocontinuous because coverings of objects of X' agree with their coverings in X_tau, gets the morphism g with g^{-1} the restriction functor (Sites, when-shriek), then compares the Cech complexes case by case (affine objects, Case II, and the final display H^p(U'_n, F|) = H^p(g^{-1}h_{x,n}, g^{-1}F)); long self-contained argument. Retained author proof at lines 4462-4618.
